An outlaw (Henry Fonda) working for a railroad magnate fights a stranger (Charles Bronson) for a New Orleans widow's (Claudia Cardinale) land.
programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West

programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.
programme.title: Pride and Prejudice

programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.
programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: Slapstick comedy from Larry, Moe, Curly and occasionally Shemp.
programme.title: The Three Stooges

programme.desc: S01 E18 — Lucy and Viv Put in a Shower Lucy decides that the time has come to install another shower.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Longden) deals with a blackmailer (Donald Calthrop) who knows that the lawman's fiancée (Anny Ondra) killed an artist.
programme.title: Blackmail

programme.desc: The 16th U.S. president (Walter Huston) is portrayed as a lawyer, orator, husband and Civil War commander.
programme.title: Abraham Lincoln

programme.desc: Ax murders follow a heart attack at an Irish castle full of mourners (William Campbell, Luana Anders, Bart Patton).
programme.title: Dementia 13

programme.desc: Rejected by a young woman (Hayley Mills) in London, a scientist (John Hurt) retreats to Antarctica to study the penguin.
programme.title: Mr. Forbush and the Penguins

programme.desc: An Army deserter (Ray Milland) joins a gambler (Barbara Stanwyck) and a miner (Barry Fitzgerald) against a former slave-trader building a private empire.
programme.title: California

programme.desc: An electrician (Richard Hatch), a TV newswoman (Kay Lenz) and a mad scientist enter a dimension ruled by a warlord (John Saxon).
programme.title: Prisoners of the Lost Universe

programme.desc: An outlaw gets even with the Wells Fargo agent who put him in prison by making him the target of bounty hunters.
programme.title: Gunfight in Black Horse Canyon

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: Incompatible friends (Bob Hope, Lucille Ball), taken for granted by their spouses, fall in love after having to spend time alone together.
programme.title: The Facts of Life

programme.desc: Flashbacks tell the story of a tenderfoot who rose to glory by gunning down the outlaw terrorizing his small town.
programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance

programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Utopia

programme.desc: Adm. Kirk (William Shatner), Mr. Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Dr. McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and crew embark in the overhauled Enterprise to find an intelligent entity called VGER.
programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture

programme.desc: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.
programme.title: Don't Knock the Twist

programme.desc: A woman contemplating divorce from her husband recalls their early years together and the tragedies that ensued.
programme.title: Penny Serenade

programme.desc: A cowboy escorts a young half-Native American girl, whose mother has recently died. He must find her white father in order to claim her hefty inheritance.
programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies

programme.desc: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.
programme.title: Gun the Man Down

programme.desc: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.
programme.title: The Man From Utah

programme.desc: Groucho, Chico, Harpo and Zeppo take advantage of hotel guests during the Florida land boom.
programme.title: The Cocoanuts

programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.
programme.title: All About Eve

programme.desc: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.
programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story

programme.desc: A widowed lawyer with two bright children defends a black man falsely accused of raping a white woman in the 1930s Alabama.
programme.title: To Kill a Mockingbird

programme.desc: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.
programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner

programme.desc: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.
programme.title: Charade

programme.desc: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."
programme.title: The Producers

programme.desc: Tragedy follows when a new-to-town, troublemaking teen meets other anguished children of feckless parents.
programme.title: Rebel Without a Cause

programme.desc: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.
programme.title: Divorce American Style

programme.desc: After being shot in a gunfight, Hopalong Cassidy sets out to settle the war between cattlemen who each accuse the other of stealing their livestock.
programme.title: Hopalong Cassidy Enters

programme.desc: A circus performer falls for an heir in the 1840s New Orleans during Mardi Gras.
programme.title: Dixiana

programme.desc: An 1880s Brooklyn boy is summoned to England by his grandfather and raised as a lord.
programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy

programme.desc: Wolf Benson is a ruthless outlaw in search of a new identity. After chucking innocent cowboy Gene Autry off a train, he steals Gene's luggage and takes on his identity before continuing on a murderous and merciless crime spree.
programme.title: Oh, Susanna

programme.desc: A matinée idol turns to alcohol when his wife's acting career starts to take off and his own popularity begins to dwindle.
programme.title: A Star Is Born
